gate.title: Locked point-guided T1/T2/FLAIR frontend with PFGR-Lite final-Z contract

automated_checks.description: Run the CPU synthetic point-guided and PFGR-Lite suite, including frontend smoke, target boundary, and generic-forward fail-closed behavior.
Compile the point-guided frontend, PFGR-Lite final-Z services, and focused tests.
Reject whitespace errors in the working-tree diff.

human_gate.policy: Automated checks collect software evidence only. This runner cannot approve the Human Gate; a human must review the locked boundary and record any decision outside this runner.
questions: Does the implementation preserve the T1/T2/FLAIR input, RAS-mm coordinates, explicit spacing, deterministic points, bounded 2 mm displacement, fixed 4 mm supports, and compact semantic-aware PoU contracts?
Does the public boundary preserve target-free PFGR-Lite trajectory/policy and final-Z-only decoding, with T1ce entering only after inference for typed supervision?
Are PFGR-Lite service, writer, teacher, value-bank, policy, and metrics identities matched across checkpoints, roles, splits, and action traces without claiming a trained/scientific result?

non_claims: A passing automated gate is software-contract evidence only, not reconstruction, clinical, or novelty validation.
This software evidence does not establish a trained checkpoint, real-data/CUDA/AMP execution, reconstruction quality, clinical utility, or novelty.

Gate-C bounded dynamic trajectory, Gate-D final-Z-only decoder, Gate-E target-after-inference supervision, and PFGR-Lite services are implemented contracts; their scientific performance remains pending measured cohorts and human review.
MedicalNet pretrained provenance is not inferred from a local file hash; official source, patient-volume, and held-out evidence require separate review.
